jobs.title: Director
jobs.reason: This is a Director role with ultimate executive responsibility and a senior team of three Deputy Directors — far beyond entry-level and requiring extensive leadership experience the candidate does not have. The salary band and scope confirm a hard mismatch with the candidate's student-assistant/RA-level profile.

jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager"-level role at the Project/Regional Lead pay band, which is clearly not entry-level and implies substantial experience and likely legal-practice standing the candidate lacks. The human-rights litigation mission is a perfect interest match, but the seniority is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Fundraising Coordinator
jobs.reason: This is an entry-level Coordinator role and eligible, but it is a fundraising/development function that sits well outside the candidate's research-and-analysis strengths and interest zones, and the candidate has no dedicated fundraising experience. The human-rights employer is appealing, but the function itself offers little paper or interest fit.
jobs.salary: £32,696 per annum plus up to 5% matched pension

jobs.title: Junior Security Consultant
jobs.reason: This is a hands-on penetration-testing role whose essential requirements — practical pen-testing experience, deep technical knowledge of applications and networking, and offensive-security tooling — are well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and outside their security-operations background. It is a deep-technical cyber-security role, not a policy or intelligence-analysis position, so it is a hard skills mismatch.

jobs.title: Senior Security Consultant
jobs.reason: This is a deep-technical penetration-testing role whose core is hands-on offensive security testing across web, mobile and infrastructure — well beyond the candidate's analysis-level Python and with no security-operations background. It is also a "Senior" title, adding a seniority disqualifier; the role sits entirely outside the candidate's research/policy profile.

jobs.title: Senior Finance Manager
jobs.reason: Senior title requiring a minimum of 12 years' experience and 8+ years in people management, plus a finance/accounting qualification (CFA/CPA preferred) — far beyond the candidate's entry-level profile and outside their field entirely. Multiple hard disqualifiers (seniority and required experience) apply.

jobs.title: Call for Applicants: Advisory Committee — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for "experts" to join an unpaid Advisory Committee, not a genuine paid entry-level role, and it seeks established practitioners with regional expertise in East Africa, Latin America or Southeast Asia — a level and profile the candidate does not meet. The human-rights subject is on-mission, but it is neither paid nor a real vacancy for this candidate.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow or Senior Policy Fellow, US Development Policy Program
jobs.reason: Location is a hard filter (London only) and this post is based in Washington DC with no London or fully-remote-UK option. It is also a Fellow / Senior Fellow-level role above entry level.

jobs.title: Fellow, Climate policy & development
jobs.reason: A "Fellow" role at CGD is a senior, experienced research position above entry level, which trips the seniority disqualifier despite the London location. Climate-and-development policy also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones.

jobs.title: Sustainability Manager
jobs.reason: A "Manager" title requiring GHG verification and sustainability consulting/advisory expertise — not entry-level and demanding specialist technical qualifications the candidate lacks. It also falls entirely outside the candidate's international-law, security and geopolitical-risk interest zones.

jobs.title: Advisory Committee Member — Project on Criminalisation of Environmental Human Rights Defenders
jobs.reason: This is a call for established "experts" to sit on an Advisory Committee, not an entry-level paid role — it is a voluntary/expert advisory position requiring senior-level experience and connection to defender movements the candidate lacks. Although the human-rights and securitisation subject matter aligns with the candidate's interests, the level and nature of the position are a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Customer Care Team Leader
jobs.reason: A Team Leader role requiring proven experience managing a customer service team — a management-level position the candidate's student-assistant background cannot meet, so it trips the not-entry-level disqualifier. It is also outside all three interest zones, being an operational customer-service role in educational publishing.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor
jobs.reason: Ineligible on multiple hard grounds: a "Lead" title requiring an engineering/physics Master's plus IRCA/ICA auditor qualification and nuclear-industry experience the candidate lacks, and it requires French at level C (fluency), which exceeds the candidate's B1. The role is entirely outside the candidate's field and skill set.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant OR Principal Consultant, Nature Research Intelligence
jobs.reason: Senior / Principal titles requiring "significant experience" and "several years" in research consulting plus demonstrated leadership — a clear non-entry-level role the candidate does not meet. The higher-education-analytics topic is only tangential to the core interest zones anyway, so the level mismatch is a hard disqualifier.

jobs.title: Legal Adviser (AD.07.4)
jobs.reason: Requires an admitted attorney with a law degree and 3 years post-qualification experience — the candidate is not a qualified lawyer and lacks the required admission and experience, two independent hard disqualifiers. The work is general legal practice rather than the candidate's core interest areas.

jobs.title: FM Campus Services/FM Housekeeping Services General Assistants (Cleaners)-Campus
jobs.reason: This is a cleaning / housekeeping role whose essentials (cleaning experience, BICSc training, manual handling, Health & Safety) are entirely outside the candidate's research and policy profile — a very poor paper fit despite being technically open and paid. It sits in none of the interest zones and offers no relevant skills alignment, so it barely warrants surfacing.

jobs.title: D365 and Power Platform Solution Architect
jobs.reason: This is a senior enterprise-software architect role requiring proven, hands-on experience implementing Microsoft D365 and Power Platform solutions, ERP/CRM architecture, DevOps and data engineering — deep-technical requirements far beyond the candidate's analysis-level skills, and it is an architect (senior/lead) position, not entry-level. Although Control Risks is a core zone (b) firm, this is an internal IT function with no research or geopolitical-analysis content.

jobs.title: Field Station Manager.2.05 - AD.07
jobs.reason: A "Manager" role requiring a BSc Honours in Nature Conservation / Wildlife Management plus at least 3 years' experience and GIS / veld-management competencies — none of which the candidate holds. It is entirely outside the candidate's field and level, and the specialist qualifications are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Consultant / Senior Consultant, VAT, Tax Advisory and Compliance
jobs.reason: This is a specialist VAT tax role requiring a CTA (or equivalent) qualification and strong UK VAT technical skills, plus it targets assistant-manager/manager level — none of which the candidate has. Despite Teneo being a zone (b) firm, this is a technical tax-advisory position entirely outside the candidate's research/policy skill set and level.

jobs.title: Careers Consultant (Trainee)

It also demands essential careers-education, resource-management and service-promotion experience the candidate does not hold, and the field (careers advising / employability) is well outside all three interest zones.

Crisis Action works on conflict and atrocity prevention, which is a strong interest match, but the paper fit on the comms-specialist side is weak and the level is uncertain. Location is unspecified rather than tied elsewhere, so the London-only filter does not exclude it.

jobs.title: Advisory Board Member
jobs.reason: An advisory board seat is a senior, expert-level appointment, not an entry-level paid role for someone at the candidate's career stage. The mission fits, but the level is a hard mismatch.

jobs.title: Speculative Application
